description: Four-pole resonant low pass filter modelled on the Moog ladder, with frequency and resonance under knob and CV control

params.text: Sets the cutoff frequency, 20Hz to 6000Hz, with the frequency in use shown in the green display, though the maker's manual gives the top of the range as 7000Hz
Sets the resonance, 0 to 4, with the filter ringing hard towards the top of its travel

inputs.text: Each volt here moves the cutoff by 1000Hz, added to the FREQ knob and clamped to 20Hz and 6000Hz
Each volt here adds 0.1 to the resonance, and the total is clamped to 0.1 and 4
The signal to be filtered; with nothing patched here the output stays at 0V

outputs.text: The low pass output of the filter

notes: The filter runs only while both IN and OUT are patched; with either one unpatched OUT is held at 0V, while the green display keeps following the FREQ knob and its CV.
